chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Saʿīd al-Aʿraj and Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

If you have begun the salat (prayer) and forgot to give the adhan and iqamah, then remembered before you bow in rukuʿ, then turn away, give the adhan and iqamah, and begin the salat (prayer). But if you have already bowed in rukuʿ, then complete your salat (prayer).

key_terms.تَرْكَعَ: to perform rukuʿ, the bowing position in salat (prayer)
key_terms.تُؤَذِّنَ: to pronounce the adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.تُقِيمَ: to pronounce the iqamah, the immediate call marking the start of prayer
key_terms.فَأَتِمَّ: complete and carry through to the end
key_terms.فَانْصَرِفْ: turn away from the prayer and discontinue it at that point

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they forget the adhan and iqamah before starting salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who begins salat (prayer) without the adhan and iqamah out of forgetfulness. If he remembers before rukuʿ, he should restart after performing them; if he remembers after rukuʿ, he should continue and complete the prayer.
